meta.title: About us
meta.description: GastroSpecs helps restaurant equipment traders buy at factory prices and helps food businesses design and equip their kitchens. Factory-direct from China, shipped worldwide.

hero.title: We help restaurant equipment traders buy at the right price.
hero.lead: GastroSpecs connects equipment dealers and food businesses with vetted factories in China. We secure factory pricing, inspect every order and design the kitchen around the equipment, so you buy with confidence and sell with a better margin.

traders.label: For traders & distributors
traders.title: Factory prices, without the risk
traders.text: You know your market; we know the factories. We source the equipment your customers ask for at factory prices, check every order before it ships and coordinate the shipping, so you can focus on selling.
